notes: Products tab redesigned around per-product cards. Each card shows seats owned/assigned/available, cost per seat + monthly total, renewal date, and a family-coded accent rail (Conditional Access Vault, Identity Health, License Insights). The old single-plan hero is gone — every owned product gets its own row instead of being collapsed into 'primary plan + N more'

Products tab split into Overview + Assignment sub-tabs. Overview = product cards + buy/upgrade CTA. Assignment = per-tenant bundle table (no longer buried below the cards). Switching tabs preserves your URL and back-button works as expected

Cancel-at-period-end now sits inline with each card's renewal info instead of in a separate footer row. Status pills only show when something needs your attention (Cancels DATE / Trial) — the decorative 'Active' pill is gone since every card in the list is active anyway
Every customer-facing 'CA Vault' now reads as 'Conditional Access Vault' in full. The 'New release available' update modal is wider so the portal+backend version diff rows have room to breathe
